decisions.reason: The air quality sensor module remains relevant for indoor monitoring and no direct successor is indicated.
Voltage measurement is a core function of the modular platform and is likely to continue.
MQTT proxy supports a key connectivity feature and software is typically maintained alongside new firmware.
CAN bus remains a standard in industrial and automotive applications, so the module is likely retained.
CO2 sensors have increased demand for indoor air quality and are complementary to other environmental modules.
Touch panel accessories may face replacement by newer display options, but still likely kept for now.
